transport.depth_convention: root container is depth 1; scalar leaves do not add container depth

canonical_json.scalar_spelling: ECMAScript JSON.stringify for strings and finite binary64; -0 becomes 0
canonical_json.authority_numbers: protocol trust values must be JS-safe integers
canonical_json.number_formatter: pinned serde_json shortest-roundtrip digits with ECMAScript notation thresholds

crypto.attestation_digest: SHA256 canonical holder fields including tag, excluding attestation_digest

release_proof.test_schema_validator: jsonschema 4.26.0; BROKER_SCHEMA_PYTHON selects an explicit local interpreter

SEM.GIT_REF_UTF8_BYTES.semantic_only_reason: Draft maxLength counts Unicode characters; no standard UTF-8 byte-length assertion keyword. Explicitly classified by Web 5560759690.

SEM.WIRE_CANONICAL.accepted_semantic_law: 4-byte BE length, <=65536 payload bytes, exact frame length; canonical binary64/UTF16-key-order JSON; reject raw duplicate keys, invalid UTF8 and noncanonical spelling
SEM.WIRE_CANONICAL.semantic_only_reason: Parsed instance has lost duplicate keys and raw serialization; schema cannot constrain framing bytes.

SEM.RESOURCE_BYTES.accepted_semantic_law: string <=4096 UTF8 bytes; canonical target<=2048, outcome<=4096, payload<=8192, receipt<=16384 bytes; enforce before trust
SEM.RESOURCE_BYTES.semantic_only_reason: Character counts and object shapes do not give aggregate canonical serialization UTF8 size.

SEM.TARGET_HASH.semantic_only_reason: Cryptographic recomputation over another value is not a Draft assertion.

SEM.OPERATION_INTEGRITY.accepted_semantic_law: logical_operation_digest hashes exact logical field subset; provider_operation_key = gpr: + operation_id; operation_digest hashes persisted row with lock_id/source_digest and target_identity_json mapping
SEM.OPERATION_INTEGRITY.semantic_only_reason: Digest recomputation and equality to a value-derived string are not Draft assertions.

SEM.OUTCOME_INTEGRITY.accepted_semantic_law: evidence_digest hashes outcome without itself; provider key derived from operation_id; target hash

SEM.RECEIPT_INTEGRITY.accepted_semantic_law: receipt_id hashes receipt without itself; created_at >= lease.issued_at
SEM.RECEIPT_INTEGRITY.semantic_only_reason: Cryptographic recomputation and comparison to another variable timestamp.

SEM.LEASE_TIME.accepted_semantic_law: expires_at > issued_at, including holder and pre-recovery lease timestamps
SEM.LEASE_TIME.semantic_only_reason: Draft lacks ordering comparison to a sibling variable value.

SEM.CHAIN.accepted_semantic_law: contiguous sequence/prior, same run/namespace/start/authority/lease, immutable candidate introduced only by TRANSITION_PREVIEW, no post-terminal receipt, monotonic times, hash of receipts
SEM.CHAIN.semantic_only_reason: Variable-index predecessor/value relationships, arbitrary equality and cryptographic recomputation.

SEM.MUTATION_HISTORY.accepted_semantic_law: unique event IDs, operation binding, exact index+1 sequence, prior event ID, monotonic times, allowed predecessor transitions, final state equals final event; each event hash
SEM.MUTATION_HISTORY.semantic_only_reason: Uniqueness of a projected field and arbitrary adjacent-value relationships are not Draft assertions; finite per-index shape is separately SCHEMA_EXPRESSIBLE.

SEM.RECOVERY_EVIDENCE.accepted_semantic_law: component observed timestamps <= observed_at; zero-operation inventory digest of three named empty arrays
SEM.RECOVERY_EVIDENCE.semantic_only_reason: Variable chronology and cryptographic recomputation; zero numeric constants separately schema-expressible.

SEM.RECOVERY_RECORD.accepted_semantic_law: N+1 replacement fence and equal high-water; terminal ID=digest; evidence digest/recovery hash; named evidence bindings and replacement-allocation bindings
SEM.RECOVERY_RECORD.semantic_only_reason: Arithmetic and variable cross-object equality / cryptographic recomputation.

SEM.REQUEST_BINDING.accepted_semantic_law: validated response ID equals originating valid request ID; operation/value kind equal originating operation; MUTATION_OUTCOME evidence ID equals operation ID
SEM.REQUEST_BINDING.semantic_only_reason: Cross-envelope equality and arbitrary within-envelope operation ID equality.

SEM.HOLDER_AUTH.accepted_semantic_law: domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 over holder excluding tag/digest; attestation_digest excludes only itself; verify with supplied test/production key before trusting authentication
SEM.HOLDER_AUTH.semantic_only_reason: Secret-key authentication and cryptographic recomputation; structural validate alone is not authentication.
